code: # Normally, I would advocate the use of the phylo_path and average   # functions, but this code shows how to average any set of models. Note   # that not many checks are implemented, so you may want to be careful and   # make sure the DAGs make sense and contain the same variables!   candidates <- define_model_set(     A = NL ~ BM,     B = NL ~ LS,     .common = c(LS ~ BM, DD ~ NL)   )   fit_cand <- lapply(candidates, est_DAG, rhino, rhino_tree,                      model = 'lambda', method = 'logistic_MPLE')   ave_cand <- average_DAGs(fit_cand)   coef_plot(ave_cand)

title: phylopath 1.3.2
text: release bug fixes small edge cases, minor improvements reporting, adds unit tests, review Claude. Bug fix: CICc calculated number parameters exactly one less number species, silently returned Inf instead NA. Affected models now return NA. Bug fix: phylo_par column now correctly reports alpha parameter case GLMs. Bug fix: model sets models named kept empty names others, made models impossible select best() choice(). Unnamed models partially named set now labelled way fully unnamed set. Bug fix: automatic model labels ran Z, giving models beyond 26th missing name. Labelling now continues AA, AB, . Bug fix: notice pointing show_warnings() shown one model produced warning, single warning went unmentioned. Bug fix: show_warnings() error variables two levels appended FALSE messages. best() average() now return informative error CICc calculated one models, rather failing uninformative error. Informative errors now returned variable used causal models column data, order argument contain exactly variables used models, two causal models given name. est_DAG() now defaults model = "lambda" method = "logistic_MPLE", matching phylo_path(). Previously arguments defaults, calling est_DAG() without failed. Bug fix: implemented consistent handling small p-values avoidance numerical underflow. Updated ggplot2 code remove deprecated functionality. Fixed several inaccuracies vignettes, including reference function exist, restored two coef_plot() examples introduction commented . Added unit test suite covering d-separation basis set, model comparison statistics, model averaging, plotting functions.

title: phylopath 1.2.0
text: CRAN release: 2023-10-09 Replaced parallel processing based parallel package pbapply use future instead. Use e.g. future::plan("multisession", workers = n) enable parallel processing model comparison (parallel dsep statements) model estimation (using bootstrapping). Fixed bug longer allowed parallel processing phylo_path. Fixed bug range width scale paths plot.fitted_DAG incorrectly set max(weight), instead max(abs(weight)). (Thanks Yu Xu report.) Better user messaging documentation around use boot parameter. Update binary vignette include info convergence warnings.

title: phylopath 1.1.3
text: CRAN release: 2021-10-04 Fixed bug made phylo_path fail pass additional (…) arguments correctly phylolm. Add informative error trying plot DAG without paths. Updated plotting functions work new ggraph releases. Fixed regression parallel usage phylo_path due S3 inheritance issue cluster (#16, thanks Simon Greenhill report).

title: phylopath 1.1.2
text: CRAN release: 2019-12-07 Prepare R v4.0.0. Bug fix: low p-values cause underflow result infinite C statistics. p-values now set least size machine accuracy (.e. 2 * 10^-16). Warnings now correctly reported.

title: phylopath 1.1.1

title: phylopath 1.1.0
text: CRAN release: 2019-07-12 Bug fix: possible get CICc values summary output valid. Specifically, calculate CICc division (n - 1 - q), n number observations (species) q number parameters causal model. lead infinite CICc n == q + 1, flipped CICc n < q + 1. typically occur attempting fit models species (e.g. < 10). New behavior set CICc NA n insufficient, give warning. Removed dependencies dplyr tidyr, added tibble.

title: phylopath 1.0.1
text: CRAN release: 2018-07-08 Fixed bug return wrong model error messages. Improved reporting warnings, show_warnings() function added. Citation info now points PeerJ paper.

title: phylopath 1.0.0
text: CRAN release: 2017-11-03 Citation info now points bioRxiv paper. modeling functions now completely rely phylolm package, longer use ape. major change, possibly change outcomes existing analyses (can happen chaning modeling package). , however, several good reasons make change, think make worth trouble. Firstly, package much faster large trees, effect compounded phylopath one may fit dozen models. Secondly, think important confidence intervals around regression coefficients, available ape::binaryPGLMM. Thirdly, phylolm makes easy use larger variety models evolution, including two versions OU early burst, can simply set using model parameter. Lastly, phylolm() phyloglm() functions give uniform results, makes easier code situation may use . phylo_path related methods now deal automatically continuous binary data. separate binary functions methods disappeared longer needed. Mixing binary continious data models now allowed. variable order d-seperation statements now better follows causal flow DAG. Added plot() method phylopath.summary objects, shows weights p-values different models. coef_plot() gained error_bar, order_by, arguments. first allows user choose confidence invervals standard errors, second order paths several methods, last two can used select certain paths. Plotting methods causal models now support manual layout. Plotting fitted DAG’s now uses edge width instead color indicate, standardized regression coefficient strength, can reverted using type argument. Added define_model_set() convenience function building models, avoids repeated calls DAG() argument supply paths shared models. needed specify isolate variables. Old code using DAG() continues work normal. Added support additional arguments passed gls phylo_path. can helpful, example, setting fitting method maximum likelihood (method = "ML").

title: phylopath 0.3.1
text: CRAN release: 2017-08-09 ####Bugfixes: package broke due update purrr, now fixed (reported Christoph Liedtke, @hcliedtke). package depends recent version nlme, wasn’t specified. package versions dependencies now defined (reported @ManuelaGonzalez).

title: phylopath 0.3.0
text: CRAN release: 2017-07-06 Added support completely binary models, fitted ape::binaryPGLMM. Use phylo_path_binary() compare models. average(), best() choice() now S3 generics handle continuous binary versions. Usage designed close continuous version possible. est_DAG_binary() powers binary S3 methods. plot functions used DiagrammeR now use ggraph instead. gives much control positioning nodes, allows plot multiple models . Exporting plots also becomes much easier. can now plot list causal models plot_model_set(). creates faceted plot nodes kept location, makes easier spot models different.

title: phylopath 0.2.3
text: CRAN release: 2017-03-23 NA values data variables models, rows now dropped data message. Use na.rm = FALSE revert old behavior. PGLS models fail, informative error now returned user. phylo_path() now checks row.names line tree tip labels. tree contains surplus species, gets pruned size message. includes cases species dropped due missing values. citation() now correctly refers methods paper Von Hardenberg & Gonzalez-Voyer first package second.

title: phylopath 0.2.2
text: CRAN release: 2017-01-04 Fewer models now fitted using phylo_path(), since duplicated independence statements now fitted . leads significant reduction running time many cases, especially many models considered. Implemented support parallel processing phylo_path() using parallel argument. phylo_path() now shows progress bar. New function added (choice()) simple wrapper around est_DAG(). adds best() average() allowing choosing model final model, encourages users always pick lowest CICc model. Prepared plotting functions new release DiagrammeR, v0.9 now required.

title: phylopath 0.2.1
text: CRAN release: 2016-11-10 IMPORTANT: Faulty model averaging fixed. often introduced due differences matrix ordering. Averaging results versions 0.2.1 trusted. Using ape::corBrownian() longer returns error. Averaging less likely fail due errors nlme::intervals().

title: phylopath 0.2.0
text: CRAN release: 2016-10-05 phylo_path() become streamlined functionality moved functions. phylopath object now contains necessary models data, summary() used obtain results table, best() average() used extract fit best average model. See vignette details. Model averaging arbitrary models now possible average_DAGs(). Model averaging now supports conditional full model averaging. old est_DAG() new average_DAGs() now return objects new class fitted_DAG, ’s separate plot method. plot method objects class DAG simplified. Model averaging now returns standard errors confidence intervals based MuMIn package (issue #1). new function plot_coefs plotting regression coefficients confidence intervals added.
